title: Wall Mount Soap Dish Solid Brass 4.5-Inch Dottingham Collection Bath Accessory | Allied Brass
description:
Add a wall mount soap dish to keep soap handy while reducing countertop clutter in the bathroom. This Dottingham collection soap holder / soap dish accessory is crafted from solid brass and installs with concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look.

Highlights:
- Wall mounted design helps keep the countertop clean and organized
- Solid brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for an uncluttered appearance
- Installation hardware included; easy to install
- Coordinates with the Dottingham collection for matching transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Dimensions: 4.5 in L x 3.5 in W x 3 in H
- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Multiple designer finish options available
